crossRefs.note: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you, unless I speak to you…

translations.web: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.
translations.bsb: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other one is not edified.
translations.kjv: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is ➔ not edified.
translations.asv: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
